stakeholders.name: Jiuling Lithium (Nigeria Project)
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Exploration, mining and chemical processing (lithium carbonate plant)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Developing a $200m lithium processing factory in Nasarawa LGA in partnership with Nasarawa State Government.
stakeholders.notes: Focused on lithium ore-to-chemical processing for EV battery value chains.

stakeholders.name: Avatar New Energy Materials Nigeria Ltd
stakeholders.currentProjects: Operating a lithium processing plant in Lafia area to process locally mined lithium ore.
stakeholders.notes: Part of new wave of Chinese-backed lithium processors in Nasarawa.

stakeholders.name: Canmax Technologies (Nigeria Lithium Project)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Investing in Nigerian lithium supply and processing facilities across multiple states including Nasarawa.
stakeholders.notes: Integrated into global battery materials supply chain.

stakeholders.name: Canmax / Chinese Lithium Consortia (Kogi Projects)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Securing lithium pegmatite fields and ASM off-take agreements in parts of Kogi State.
stakeholders.notes: Linked to larger Nigeria critical minerals investments.

stakeholders.name: Tree Mines Global
stakeholders.currentProjects: Developing small-scale gold operations in Kabba-Bunu and exploring for lithium and other critical minerals in Kogi and Kwara States.
stakeholders.notes: Important Nigerian-owned player linking ASM to formal markets.

stakeholders.name: Thor Explorations  (Lithium mining)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Holder of ~600 km2 of lithium exploration tenure including parts of Oyo State, parallel to its Segilola gold success.
stakeholders.notes: Targeting lithium-bearing pegmatites within the Nigerian Basement Complex.

stakeholders.name: Thor Explorations ( Lithium)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Exploring lithium pegmatites in Ekiti State as part of its critical minerals strategy.
stakeholders.notes: Builds on legacy of gemstone and pegmatite mining around Ijero-Ekiti.

stakeholders.name: Thor Explorations ( Lithium)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Part of a multi-state lithium exploration package spanning Kwara and neighbouring states.

stakeholders.name: Tree Mines Global
stakeholders.currentProjects: Holds solid minerals properties in Kwara including gold and associated critical minerals.
stakeholders.notes: Engages with women and local communities in its operations.

stakeholders.name: Various Chinese-backed Lithium & Pegmatite Operators
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Early-stage mining and export of pegmatite ores
stakeholders.currentProjects: Clusters of pegmatite and lithium-bearing operations emerging in parts of Cross River State.
stakeholders.notes: Often linked to informal/ASM supply chains with limited public corporate visibility.

stakeholders.name: Kelechi Minerals Nigeria Ltd
stakeholders.currentProjects: Active across Kogi, Kwara, Nasarawa, Ekiti and Oyo with interests also extending into Plateau-linked belts; focuses on lithium and associated critical minerals.
stakeholders.notes: Positions itself as a critical minerals champion for Nigeria’s energy transition.

stakeholders.name: Hasetins Commodities Ltd ( REE Plant)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Developing a $400m rare earth and critical minerals processing facility in Nasarawa State.
stakeholders.notes: Flagship African REE processing hub targeting monazite-rich concentrates from Plateau, Benue, Nasarawa and Cross River.

stakeholders.name: Hasetins Commodities Ltd (Supply Agreements)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Expected to source monazite-bearing heavy mineral sands from Plateau’s historic tin fields for processing in Nasarawa.
stakeholders.notes: Links legacy tin tailings to new REE value chains.

stakeholders.name: Hasetins Commodities Ltd (Supply Agreements)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Targeting REE-bearing sands and concentrates from Benue for processing in Nasarawa.
stakeholders.notes: Transforms scattered REE resources into a coherent value chain.

stakeholders.name: Hasetins Commodities Ltd (Coastal Sands REE Initiative)
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Off-take and processing of coastal sand concentrates
stakeholders.currentProjects: Exploring supply relationships for monazite-bearing coastal sands in Cross River.
stakeholders.notes: Draws on evidence of REE-rich beach sands as a low-impact source.

stakeholders.name: Mexcon Metals Ltd (Plateau Tin Project)
stakeholders.currentProjects: Developing a tin concentrate project on three concessions in the Jos Plateau region, historically mined for tin and columbite.
stakeholders.notes: Part of efforts to revive Nigeria’s tin sector with modern processing.

stakeholders.name: Multiverse Mining & Exploration Plc
stakeholders.currentProjects: Operates tin and columbite projects in Plateau and Nasarawa States with associated critical minerals.
stakeholders.notes: One of the few Nigeria-listed mining companies with exposure to critical metals.

stakeholders.name: Multiverse Mining & Exploration Plc
stakeholders.currentProjects: Holds mineral titles in Nasarawa that include tin-columbite and associated minerals.
stakeholders.notes: Links central Nigerian tin belts into formal corporate operations.

stakeholders.name: Thor Explorations – Segilola Resources Operating Ltd
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Open-pit mining, processing and export of gold doré
stakeholders.currentProjects: Operates the Segilola Gold Mine near Ilesha, Nigeria’s first commercial-scale modern gold mine.
stakeholders.notes: Anchor gold producer and key reference project for Nigeria’s precious metals sector.

stakeholders.name: Tree Mines Global – Kabba-Bunu Gold Project
stakeholders.currentProjects: Developing small-scale gold mining operations in Kabba-Bunu area under a mining lease.
stakeholders.notes: Blends formal licensing with ASM integration in North-Central Nigeria.

stakeholders.name: Various Small & Medium Tin/Columbite Operators (Jos Plateau Cluster)
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Alluvial / hard-rock mining and primary concentration
stakeholders.currentProjects: Numerous small and medium-scale operators work historic tin and columbite fields around Jos, Barkin Ladi and Riyom.
stakeholders.notes: Feedstock for prospective REE recovery and tin value-addition projects.

stakeholders.name: Kursi Group
stakeholders.currentProjects: Mineral exploration and ASM formalisation initiatives
stakeholders.notes: Nigerian-owned mineral investment and development company

stakeholders.name: Kaduna Mining Development Company (KMDC)
stakeholders.currentProjects: State-led mineral development and PPP mining ventures
stakeholders.notes: Coordinates and promotes Kaduna State's mineral assets

stakeholders.name: Nasarawa Investment & Development Agency (NASIDA)
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Investment Facilitation → PPPs → Mineral Value Chain Expansion
stakeholders.currentProjects: Facilitating over $600m lithium & REE investments (Jiuling, Avatar, Hasetins)
stakeholders.notes: Key driver of Nasarawa’s rapid critical minerals growth

stakeholders.name: African Natural Resources and Mines Ltd. (ANRML)
stakeholders.currentProjects: $600m Integrated Iron Ore & DRI Steel Plant
stakeholders.notes: Nigeria’s most modern iron ore and DRI steel operation

stakeholders.name: National Iron Ore Mining Company (NIOMCO), Itakpe
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Iron ore mining → Beneficiation → Steel feedstock
stakeholders.currentProjects: Rehabilitation of Itakpe concentrator; supply to ASCL
stakeholders.notes: Nigeria’s primary government-owned iron ore mine
